subject: pol-con
title: (R)POL.CON.------SPT.DYM.
description: Chart on book p. 182 (SR(TRS)II-38). POL-CON (political consciousness) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SPT-DYM (spiritual dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: MT-INFO (multi-information) and INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis). From MT-INFO: POL-P (political policies). From INFO-AF-B: LK-IMP (linkage implications) and IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics). From LK-IMP: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From IF-ST-DY: MOT-DY.
